answers.core: It is not intrusive and would be useful to most Windows users when working with the Windows filesystem and Godot.
answers.workaround: This would require editing the functionality of [PR #90421](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/90421) and the Editor Settings, and any other places in the editor that give you OS file paths to copy, which would involve editing the C++ source of the Godot Engine.

title: Add an option to use '\' instead of '/' as a file path separator when using "Copy Absolute Path" in the editor's FileSystem dock
